sections.html:
Meetings open with a short business session and a program on a technique: prepared-edge, reverse applique, Broderie Perse, or the setting of a Baltimore Album. Show and tell is untimed.

The library holds out-of-print Baltimore books and a box of freezer-paper templates members may copy.

items.quote: I had never turned a needle in my life. Someone sat next to me and showed me the hitch stitch on a leaf.
items.author: Clara W.

items.quote: The holiday tea is worth the dues by itself. Every wreath block from the year is on the wall.
items.author: Margaret L.
